number: Relabel at 3 rounds (two structural differences cancelling each other). Enumeration of in-call absorption over the four state words v12..v15 (each absorbed in its own column by two message words; sets D = {m0,m1}, {m2,m3}, {m4,m5}, {m6,m7}): (a) absorption with ZERO message difference is impossible: G is a bijection of the state for fixed message words (inverse verified on 200000 random states; 0 equal outputs in 300000 pairs differing only in d). (b) Absorption with message differences works in every column and every combination: round-0 state equal (8 of 8 digest words equal at 1 round) for length alone (55/63), flags alone, length+flags (D = m4..m7, 4 message words differ), counter lo+hi, and all four; at 2 and 3 rounds 0 digest words equal in 1500 random pairs each. Absorbing only one of two differences leaves the other: 0 equal at 1 round. (c) Word-level activity: length+flags absorbed: 0, 7, 8 active calls, 8 of 8 digest words active at 3 rounds (unabsorbed 6, 8, 8). (d) Bias test, 6000 pairs: length alone r2 64 biased bits in 7 words (max 0.32), r3 none; length+flags r2 none, r3 none. Smallest residual that meets legality is 256 bits (8 words) at 3 rounds, 0 solutions of full in-call absorption: the r2 claim reproduces and gets no better at 3 rounds.
